_comment: v16 code-quality budgets — a RATCHET. Regressions fail CI. NOTE: coverage % is NOT comparable across the v16 boundary: before v16 the integration tests hit a re-implemented app (testApp.js), so only ~20 files were instrumented and the number flattered itself. v16 made tests run against the real app factory, adding 10 previously-invisible modules to the denominator. The honest companion metric improved sharply: maxFilesUncounted 32 -> 22.
